2609.04096.title: Adaptive Vision-Language Grasping via Composable Foundation Priors and Generalizable Grasp Synthesis
2609.04096.paper_summary: This paper proposes AdaRoboVLG, a task-adaptive Vision-Language-Grasp (VLG) framework that supports generalizable grasp synthesis across different robotic hands. Unlike existing VLG methods that tightly couple foundation models with end-to-end grasp policies, AdaRoboVLG learns an efficient generalizable base policy that generates and evaluates physically feasible grasp candidates through explicit kinematic mapping and force-closure-based stability estimation, while offloading task-dependent understanding to specialized foundation-model modules. These modules provide composable priors that are integrated into the grasp synthesis process, enabling contextually adaptive grasp synthesis without retraining the underlying grasp policy. Through extensive simulation and real-world experiments, we demonstrate that (i) the base policy exhibits efficient learning and strong cross-hand generalization, (ii) the framework effectively incorporates spatial, cognitive, and temporal priors to address three representative grasping challenges without compromising grasp synthesis performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, and (iii) these priors can operate jointly to enable functional grasping in cluttered and dynamic environments. These results indicate that decoupling physical grasp synthesis from task-dependent understanding provides a scalable paradigm for robotic grasping, allowing future advances in foundation models to be directly translated into improved grasp capabilities without redesigning or retraining the underlying grasp policy. Supplementary videos are available at https://adarobovlg.github.io/
2609.04096.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了AdaRoboVLG，一個任務自適應的視覺-語言-抓取（VLG）框架，支持在不同機器手之間的可泛化抓取合成。與現有的VLG方法緊密結合基礎模型和端到端抓取策略不同，AdaRoboVLG學習了一個高效的可泛化基礎策略，通過明確的運動學映射和基於力閉合的穩定性估計生成和評估物理可行的抓取候選，並將任務依賴的理解卸載到專門的基礎模型模塊中。這些模塊提供可組合的先驗，這些先驗被整合到抓取合成過程中，使得在不重新訓練基礎抓取策略的情況下實現上下文自適應的抓取合成。通過廣泛的模擬和現實世界實驗，我們證明了（i）基礎策略展現出高效的學習和強大的跨手泛化，（ii）該框架有效地整合了空間、認知和時間先驗，以解決三個代表性的抓取挑戰，並且在抓取合成性能上不妥協於最先進的方法，以及（iii）這些先驗可以共同運作，以實現雜亂和動態環境中的功能性抓取。這些結果表明，將物理抓取合成與任務依賴的理解解耦提供了一個可擴展的機器人抓取範式，使得未來基礎模型的進步能夠直接轉化為改進的抓取能力，而無需重新設計或重新訓練基礎抓取策略。補充視頻可在 https://adarobovlg.github.io/ 獲得。
